user.title: Connect to Endurain
user.description: Connect with an Endurain API key, or leave the key empty to sign in once and let Home Assistant create one.

data_description.api_key: An Endurain API key (Settings → Security → API keys). Leave empty to sign in with your username and password instead; the integration then creates a key and does not store your password.

credentials.title: Sign in to Endurain
credentials.description: Sign in once to create an API key named "Home Assistant". Your password is used only for this and is not stored.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.description: Enter the current code from your authenticator app.

step_up.title: Confirm the API key
step_up.description: Endurain accepts each code once. Wait for your authenticator app to show the next code and enter it to confirm creating the API key.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Endurain
reconfigure.description: Change the server or replace the API key. Leave the key empty to keep the current one.

data_description.api_key: A new Endurain API key. Leave empty to keep the current one.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the Endurain API key
reauth_confirm.description: The API key for {name} no longer works or expires soon. Enter a new key, or leave it empty to sign in and create one.

data_description.api_key: An Endurain API key (Settings → Security → API keys). Leave empty to sign in with your username and password instead; the integration then creates a key and does not store your password.

error.invalid_mfa: The MFA code was not accepted. Enter the next code.
error.rate_limited: Endurain is rate-limiting requests. Try again shortly.

abort.already_configured: This Endurain account is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: The Endurain API key was updated.
abort.wrong_account: The API key belongs to a different Endurain account.

auth_failed.title: Endurain authentication failed
auth_failed.description: The Endurain integration "{title}" can no longer authenticate. Details: {details}
